raw.details:
Tech Horizon 2.0:

  • Innovate. Compete. Conquer.

Event Overview:

  • National Level Hackathon | 9th&10th October 2026, Round Timings 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM
  • Guru Nanak Institutions Technical Campus (Autonomous), Hyderabad
  • Organized by:Department Of CSE(Cyber Security) & CSE(Data Science) Under IEEE Systems, Man, and Cybernetics Society (GNITC Student Branch Chapter)
  • Duration: 24-Hour Hackathon 

IMPORTANT NOTE FOR ALL PARTICIPANTS

All teams whose payment is successfully confirmed will be invited to participate in the Hackathon Round. There will be no shortlisting based on PPT submission for paid and confirmed registrations.

The PPT/idea submission is required only for event documentation, evaluation preparation, and smooth coordination of the hackathon process.

Participants are advised to complete their registration and payment as early as possible to avoid missing their slot.

Slot confirmation will be based only on successful payment completion.

Register & Complete Payment: KonfHub Registration Page

Important Note: 

  • Participants who have already paid and booked their slot have the option to stay in the assigned venue and work on further rounds.
  • Participants who choose not to stay in the venue arranged by the organizers may make their own accommodation arrangements outside the college at their own discretion and expense. The organizers and Guru Nanak Institutions Technical Campus (GNITC) shall not be responsible for any accommodation, travel, or related expenses, nor for any incidents, accidents, losses, or actions occurring outside the college campus before, during, or after the event.

About The Event:

  • TECH HORIZON 2.0 is a national-level innovation hackathon designed to bring together developers, innovators, and problem-solvers from across the country to tackle real-world challenges using cutting-edge technologies.
  • Participants will:
  • Identify impactful real-world problems
  • Design innovative and scalable solutions
  • Build functional prototypes
  • Present ideas to industry experts and judges
  • This hackathon serves as a platform to transform ideas into real innovations across multiple domains.

Key Highlights:

  • Exciting Cash Prize Pool
  • Participation Certificates for all
  • Recognition at a National Level
  • Selected projects featured in TECH HORIZON Souvenir
  • Networking with innovators & mentors
  • Optional Hyderabad sightseeing experience

Hackathon Themes:

  • Health & Biotech
  • Security & Surveillance
  • E-Commerce
  • Clean & Green Technology
  • Generative AI
  • Smart Automation
  • Blockchain & Cryptography
  • Game Development
  • Circuit Design
  • Embedded System
  • Next Gen Communication
  • Sustainable Development
  • Open Innovation (Any real-world problem)

Team Details:

  • Team Size: 3 – 6 Members
  • Eligibility: UG / PG / Students
  • Multiple teams per college allowed

Important Dates:

  • Early Bird Deadline: 20th September 2026
  • Final Registration Deadline: 30th September 2026
  • Idea Submission Deadline: 30th September 2026
  • Hackathon Dates: October 2026 (24 Hours)

Registration Fees:

  • Early Bird:
    • IEEE Members: ₹300 (Per Participant)
    • Non-IEEE Members: ₹350 (Per Participant)
  • Late Registration:
    • IEEE Members: ₹499 (Per Participant)
    • Non-IEEE Members: ₹559 (Per Participant)

Prize Pool:

  • Winner: ₹1,25,000
  • Runner-up: ₹50,000
  • Third Place: ₹25,000
  • Domain Excellence: ₹13,000 (₹1,000 per each domain)
  • Consolation prizes for each theme

Hackathon Flow:

  • Registration & Theme Selection
  • Idea Submission
  • Prototype Development (24 Hours)
  • Final Presentation & Evaluation

Evaluation Criteria:

  • Innovation & Creativity
  • Problem Relevance
  • Technical Implementation
  • Prototype Quality
  • Presentation & Clarity
  • Real-world Impact

Guidelines:

  • Original ideas only (strictly no plagiarism)
  • Teams must adhere to selected theme
  • Timely submissions are mandatory
  • Judges’ decision will be final

Additional Benefits:

  • Participation Certificates for all and multiple goodies and more exciting perks
  • National-level exposure
  • Industry recognition opportunities

Quick Access:

  • Register & Complete Payment: KonfHub Registration Page

Registration Process:

  • Click on the registration link below
  • Fill in your team details
  • Complete the payment securely via KonfHub
  • Receive confirmation on your registered email

Register & Pay Here:

  • TECH HORIZON 2.0 Registration

Refund Policy

No Refund Policy

Once the hackathon registration payment has been successfully completed, no refunds will be provided under any circumstances.

Participants are advised to carefully review their registration details before completing the payment. By making the payment, participants acknowledge and agree to this No Refund Policy.

Payment-Related Issues

If a participant experiences any issue related to the payment or registration, they must contact the hackathon organizing team within 24 hours of completing the payment. Requests received after this 24-hour period may not be considered.

Any payment-related concerns will be reviewed by the organizing team, and the final decision regarding the resolution of the issue will rest with the organizers.

By completing the registration payment, the participant confirms that they have read, understood, and agreed to the terms of this Refund Policy.
